thread:
IncidentBot: ALERT: High error rate: internal service discovery failures in us-east-1 — multiple SRV lookup failures and CoreDNS NXDOMAIN for redis-svc.namespace.svc.cluster.local. Error spike at 2024-05-10T10:24:50Z. Pager: sam (on-call SRE) :rotating_light:

sam (on-call SRE): seeing it — pods failing healthchecks that hit redis. curl against kube-dns returns NXDOMAIN for the redis SRV.

maria (platform eng): confirmed from control plane: CoreDNS CPU spiked on node pool cdns-pool-us-e-1, several restarts in last 5m. Logs show `plugin/forward: read udp: i/o timeout` repeated.

lee (infra): looks like upstream resolver timeouts — likely network path to cloud DNS resolver in that AZ. cross-region route tables look fine. Any recent network changes?

sam (on-call SRE): no infra changes in last 24h per deploy-bot.

deploy-bot: No deploys detected in last 24h for kube-system or coredns.

maria (platform eng): attaching snippets:
```
# kubectl -n kube-system logs coredns-5d7f9 -c coredns
E05010 10:23:12.345678 plugin/forward: read udp 10.0.0.10:39245->8.8.8.8:53: i/o timeout
E05010 10:23:12.345700 plugin/errors: 2 0 "dns lookup failed"
```

sam (on-call SRE): impact assessment: apps in us-east-1 rely on SRV records for internal services (redis, memcached, consul). We are seeing increased 5xx and timeouts for customer-facing routes that depend on these caches. Initial customer impact: intermittent latency spikes for a subset of API calls; no widespread data loss reported.

Taylor (support): raising customer comms: which customers are affected? Can we get a concise severity?

sam (on-call SRE): severity: P1 for internal platform — public-facing degraded for small % of requests. Recommend status page incident note: "Partial degradation, impacted region us-east-1, working on mitigation."

lee (infra): mitigation options: 1) scale CoreDNS replica count and nodes, 2) point CoreDNS forwarders to alternate resolver in different AZ, 3) apply iptables DNAT to redirect to fallback resolver, 4) static /etc/hosts (not viable at scale).

maria (platform eng): we can scale CoreDNS quickly: `kubectl scale deployment/coredns -n kube-system --replicas=6` — current replicas 3. Also we can update CoreDNS ConfigMap to increase `forward` timeout and set `health` plugin thresholds.

sam (on-call SRE): do it. I’ll start scale and monitor.

sam (on-call SRE): `kubectl scale deployment/coredns -n kube-system --replicas=6` — scaling now.

maria (platform eng): making a quick patch to ConfigMap to set `forward . 8.8.8.8 8.8.4.4 { policy random; health_check 5s; max_fails 3; }` and `proxy_timeout 5s`. Pushing change to cluster.

deploy-bot: ConfigMap update applied to kube-system/coredns-config — rolling restart started.

sam (on-call SRE): after scale+config: CoreDNS restart churn decreased, error rates dropping but still occasional NXDOMAIN. Getting correlation with a subset of nodes — edge nodes in us-east-1a showing packet loss to resolver IPs.

lee (infra): network telemetry shows increased packet drops on ENI eni-0a12b3 in us-east-1a between host and NAT gateway. Route checks show NAT gateway healthy but we see high retransmits. Opening cloud provider support ticket (case: 12345678) for suspected AZ network degradation.

maria (platform eng): As interim, I'm updating CoreDNS forwarders to use internal VPC resolver (169.254.169.253) and adding secondary to us-east-1b resolver IPs to avoid NAT path. Applying now.

sam (on-call SRE): applied — pushing rollout. Monitoring metrics.

sam (on-call SRE): latency to redis for failing pods improving. Error rate in dashboards down 70%. Support: can you draft an update?

Taylor (support): Posting to status page: `Partial service degradation in us-east-1 impacting internal service discovery. Engineering investigating; mitigation in progress.` Will tag customers with known usage.

maria (platform eng): cloud provider responded: transient network fabric issue in us-east-1a affecting egress to internet/NAT. They are diverting traffic; ETA 40-60m.

sam (on-call SRE): plan for next 60m: keep CoreDNS replicas at 6, keep forwarders pointed to internal resolver and cross-AZ resolver list. If provider fix delayed beyond 2h, we execute plan B: cordon/evacuate problematic nodes and migrate pods off us-east-1a, or failover services to us-east-2 region (requires rollback plan for stateful services).

lee (infra): I'll prepare node eviction playbook and a job to migrate stateful sets with `podDisruptionBudget` considerations.

maria (platform eng): note: Consul/etcd lookups also had increased latency — but primary issue is DNS path. We should add a long-term fix: run CoreDNS with health-aware forwarders and cross-AZ resolver endpoints, and add `upstream` caching in critical services.

sam (on-call SRE): handoff: my shift ends in 35m. If provider doesn't resolve by then, @oncall-rotation-bot please page next oncall `lee` and hand off.

oncall-rotation-bot: Handoff scheduled: pager to lee in 35 minutes.

sam (on-call SRE): quick note for handoff: actions taken — scaled coredns 3->6, updated forwarders to internal resolver + us-east-1b, applied shorter forward timeout, opened provider ticket 12345678, status page updated. Remaining risks: residual NXDOMAIN until provider completes fabric reroute; possible need to evacuate us-east-1a nodes.

lee (infra): acknowledged. I’ll watch provider updates and prep node migration steps. If we need to evacuate, I’ll coordinate with platform to sequence stateful sets.

Taylor (support): leaving a pinned message in incident channel for customer-facing timeline. I’ll loop in account teams for top customers.

maria (platform eng): provider update: they have partial fix live; telemetry shows packets rerouted away from affected fabric. CoreDNS metrics now stable for 15m with error rate ~1% baseline.

sam (on-call SRE): marking mitigation as successful for now. Will keep monitoring for one more hour then close thread. Recommend postmortem: assign to maria + lee + sam, include timeline, root cause (AZ path flaky), mitigation (forwarder config + replica scaling + node eviction playbook), and customer impact notes.

sam (on-call SRE): ACTIONS: create postmortem doc, estimate severity P1 for internal platform, customer visible partial degradation, send to ops@redwood.com.

maria (platform eng): created postmortem draft: link https://wiki.redwood.internal/incidents/1715467890 (placeholder).

sam (on-call SRE): handing off to lee for watch — I’m pausing rota. Thanks team :thumbsup:

lee (infra): Standing by. Will escalate to provider if socket drops reappear.

IncidentBot: Incident 1715467890 status changed to "mitigated" by sam (on-call SRE) at 2024-05-10T13:00:00Z."
